metadata.article_title: Appeal against conviction by High Court in certain cases

article.title: Appeal against conviction by High Court in certain cases
article.content: Where the High Court has, on appeal, reversed an order of acquittal of an accused person and convicted him and sentenced him to death or to imprisonment for life or to imprisonment for a term of ten years or more, he may appeal to the Supreme Court.
article.html:
420Appeal against conviction by High Court in certain cases

Section 420 · Chapter XXXI

Where the High Court has, on appeal, reversed an order of acquittal of an accused person and convicted him and sentenced him to death or to imprisonment for life or to imprisonment for a term of ten years or more, he may appeal to the Supreme Court.
